notes:
Installing no longer shows you nothing. The RecCheck icon appears in the middle of the screen with a blue ring travelling around it, and goes away by itself when RecCheck comes back.

The ring travels rather than fills, and that is on purpose: a silent installer reports its progress to nobody, so a ring filling to 100% would be a number made up to look like a measurement. It says work is happening, which is what was missing. The download before it already shows a real percentage.
